directory_policies.notes.7: English policy: Generally sought: TOEFL 90/120 or 5/6, IELTS 7, DET 125 with subscores. Fall 2027 application-year cutoff is August 1, 2024; reporting validity and waiver review also apply. These sought scores are not enforced as hard rejection thresholds.

fact_summary: Duke describes generally sought scores and an August application-year cutoff, rather than unconditional numerical admission cutoffs.
